bull.b: Advancing biomarker work toward an NDA could improve the probability and speed of regulatory review for CNM-Au8 in ALS, creating a potentially meaningful development milestone and future commercialization opportunity.

An orally administered lead candidate addressing multiple neurodegenerative indications provides pipeline breadth and could support future licensing or product revenue if clinical efficacy and regulatory approval are achieved.

Deferring scheduled principal and interest payments reduces near-term cash requirements, giving management additional time to advance clinical and regulatory programs while pursuing financing or partnering options.

bear.b: Very small revenue relative to large operating and net losses shows that Clene has not achieved commercial scale. Persistently negative margins could require substantial funding before any product generates recurring revenue.

Ongoing cash outflows mean the company relies on external capital to fund operations and development. This dependence increases financing risk and may constrain the pace of clinical, regulatory, and commercial investment.

Negative equity and debt approaching total assets indicate a limited balance-sheet cushion. The resulting financial inflexibility could make additional capital more expensive and heighten dilution or restructuring risk.
